shared.title: Musclog vs {{name}}
shared.checked: Facts about {{name}} were checked on {{date}}. Free-tier limits change, so open the source in each row before you decide.
shared.nonAffiliation: Musclog is not affiliated with {{name}}. Product names belong to their owners.

strong.intro: Strong is a workout logger. Musclog logs workouts too, and tracks food as well, in one free, open-source app.

facts.them: Saves unlimited workouts, but is limited to 3 custom routines.
facts.musclog: There is no limit on routines, and nothing is locked behind a subscription.

facts.them: Strong PRO removes the routine limit: $4.99 per month or $29.99 per year (U.S. App Store prices).
facts.musclog: Free and open source (GPL-3.0). There is no paid tier.

strong.import: Musclog can import a Strong CSV export: Settings, Backups and data, Import workouts. It matches exercise names to its own catalogue and asks you about any it cannot match, and it shows a review before anything is saved. Importing the same file twice does not duplicate sessions, and an import can be undone.
strong.chooseThem: Stay with Strong if you already use it and three custom routines are enough for you.
strong.chooseMusclog: Try Musclog if you want no routine limit, food tracking in the same app, and your data kept on your device.

hevy.intro: Hevy is a workout logger with a free plan and a paid Pro plan. Musclog logs workouts and food in one free, open-source app.

facts.them: The free plan is limited to 4 routines and 7 custom exercises.
facts.musclog: There is no limit on routines or custom exercises.

facts.them: The warm-up calculator is part of Hevy Pro, not the free plan.
facts.musclog: Warm-up sets are built in and free. You can also try the warm-up calculator on this site.

hevy.import: Musclog can import a Hevy CSV export: Settings, Backups and data, Import workouts. It matches exercise names to its own catalogue and asks you about any it cannot match, and it shows a review before anything is saved. Importing the same file twice does not duplicate sessions, and an import can be undone.
hevy.chooseThem: Stay with Hevy if you already use it and the free plan limits do not get in your way.
hevy.chooseMusclog: Try Musclog if you want no routine or exercise limits, food tracking in the same app, and your data kept on your device.

myFitnessPal.intro: MyFitnessPal is a food and calorie tracker. Musclog tracks food too, and logs your workouts, in one free, open-source app.

facts.them: Barcode scanning has been a Premium feature since October 1, 2022, according to MyFitnessPal's own announcement. Free users log food by searching.

myFitnessPal.chooseThem: Stay with MyFitnessPal if you already use it, rely on its food database and are happy with the free version.
myFitnessPal.chooseMusclog: Try Musclog if you want free barcode scanning, workouts and food in one app, and your data kept on your device.
